narr: Showers and thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona from mid morning through early evening. Locally heavy rain occurred that caused flash flooding in eastern Pima and western Cochise counties.
ev: One to two inches of rain in 90 minutes caused flash flooding in the Benson and St. David areas. Several washes to overtopped in the St. David area and North Miller Rd was closed due to flooding. Ocotillo Road was closed due to flooding north of Benson.
Three hour rainfall of 2.5 fell at the headwaters of Rincon Creek, causing rapid rises in stream flow and flash flooding of Old Spanish Trail.
